info.title: Skaletek KYC API
info.description: Verify the identity of people with Skaletek eKYC. Create applicants, start verification sessions for the hosted flow or the mobile SDK, submit server-to-server verifications, request step-up checks and read results. Authenticate every request with your Skaletek API key in the `X-API-Key` header.

post.description: Creates an applicant in the authenticated partner tenant. external_id is idempotent per tenant.

delete.description: Irreversibly erases applicant PII while retaining non-PII audit anchors.

post.description: Starts an interactive verification for the applicant with the chosen workflow. Build the applicant link from the returned `token` and `session_jwt`.

post.summary: Create an upload target for API-only verification files
post.description: API-only requests may only cite storage keys issued here for the tenant.
Validates and queues an asynchronous verification without applicant UI.

document_type.title: Document Type
document_type.description: A document type code from GET /v1/catalog/document-types.

external_id.title: External Id
external_id.description: Partner's own user identifier.  Unique within the tenant; used for idempotent get-or-create logic.

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: Regulatory territory for this onboarding (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, lowercase). Drives acceptable document type suggestions.

document.description: Pre-provided identity document claim.  Optional at creation time.

CreateApplicantRequest.title: CreateApplicantRequest
CreateApplicantRequest.description: Sent by the tenant (API key auth) to register a new applicant.

token.title: Token
token.description: Opaque route token, not an authentication credential.

session_jwt.title: Session Jwt
session_jwt.description: Short-lived credential for this session only. It goes in the applicant link and cannot call partner endpoints.

UpdateApplicantRequest.title: UpdateApplicantRequest
UpdateApplicantRequest.description: Partial update — all fields are optional.

PartnerApiKey.name: X-API-Key
PartnerApiKey.description: Your Skaletek API key. Create it in the dashboard under Settings › General Settings › Configurations › API keys.
